summary: The diff implements most requirements for product filtering and description template management. However, there are notable gaps: the filter tabs do not show categories separately from shapes (REQ-66), backend methods lack admin authentication verification (REQ-73), and the default template initialization is missing (REQ-74).

missing_requirements.requirement: Filter tabs must display all unique categories from products in the system as separate tabs from shapes
missing_requirements.reason: The implementation uses shape as a proxy for category (uniqueCategories = uniqueShapes) instead of extracting actual category data from products. The AC specifies tabs should display both shapes AND categories as distinct filter options.

missing_requirements.requirement: All backend template management methods must verify admin authentication before execution
missing_requirements.reason: The diff shows backend/main.mo was modified but is truncated. No evidence of admin authentication checks in getDescriptionTemplates, createDescriptionTemplate, updateDescriptionTemplate, or deleteDescriptionTemplate methods is visible in the diff.

missing_requirements.requirement: Create a default description template in the backend initialization with the specified text
missing_requirements.reason: No evidence in the backend/main.mo diff of initialization logic that creates a default template on first deployment with the required dolphin ocarina description text.

missing_requirements.requirement: A 'Clear Filters' or 'All Products' option resets the filter state
missing_requirements.reason: While clearFilters() function exists in Marketplace.tsx, there is no visible UI button or element in the diff that allows users to trigger this function. The AC requires a user-accessible clear filters option.
